digest.component_or_area: Jira DC test harness and verification infrastructure
propositions: A real Jira 8.17.1 Server instance must be available as a testing oracle because Atlassian ended Data Center license purchases and OpenAPI/Swagger specs do not exist for DC.

The harness builds from a vendored Dockerfile pinning the addono base image by digest with -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout flags to override Cargo's 600s deploy ceiling, because the base image does not contain Jira and atlas-run downloads ~900 artifacts from maven.atlassian.com at runtime.

The smoke tests must verify PAT bearer authentication via programmatically minted tokens (POST /rest/pat/latest/tokens) and REST v2 semantics (create/read round-trip with plain-string descriptions, not ADF), proving the DC auth mode and wire format that the transport will use.

The harness runs only on native amd64 runners because arm64 emulation causes startup to exceed Cargo's hardcoded timeouts even with the override flag; acceptance evidence must be produced on an amd64 host and recorded with the architecture.

Teardown must verify every created issue returns 404 from its direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoint without consulting the search index, per ADR 0037 §3, and the session fixture must detect and refuse to run against residual projects from interrupted prior runs.

The suite skips cleanly under tests/external/ without REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1 plus a running instance, and the _live_jira_ready sentinel participates in the all-skip canary so that a run collecting jira_live tests but executing none fails the session rather than reporting a vacuous pass.
